title: Cover and Protocol
author: Ivo Sandoval
blurb: Odile Vasquez, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
